dedupe_keys.name: prospective outlook on long term energy system poles

description: Prospective Outlook on Long-term Energy System (POLES) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by EC-JRC. The POLES-JRC model is a simulation model for the development of long-term energy supply and demand scenarios, including related emissions, for the different regions of the world. It simulates technology dynamics and follows the discrete choice modelling paradigm in the decision-making process. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Software: unknown. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
